title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“江小姐，我来替你看看吧！”陈青云说道。“你认识我？”江颜有些意外。“我叫陈青云，是唐县长的秘书，之前见过您和杨副县长！”陈青云一边解释，一边弯下腰，捏住她的玉足。“啊！”江颜娇呼一声，疼的眼眶噙泪，一副楚楚可怜的样子。“你的脚踝受伤了，如果不及时化瘀，只会更加严重，我替你按摩一下吧！”陈青云说道。“你会医术？”江颜一脸狐疑。“我爷爷是老中医，从小到大，我也学了一些本事！”陈青云伸出手，在她的玉足上揉捏起来。江颜是舞蹈演员，但脚上却没有任何瑕疵，光滑如玉，十根脚趾擦着红色的指甲油，格外性感，令人忍不住把玩。也许是因为害怕，江颜浑身绷紧，微微颤抖。“别怕！我很温柔的，不会弄痛你！”陈青云说道。闻言，江颜的俏脸反而更红，就像涂抹了胭脂，娇艳欲滴。毕竟这话听起来，就好像在说那种事……但很快，她就觉得陈青云的大手仿佛有着魔力，非但缓解了疼痛，还带来了说不出的舒爽。若非她咬住红唇，恐怕就要失态叫出声了。“江小姐，淤血已经化开了，你站起来试试！”陈青云收回了手。“这么快？”江颜一下子有些失落，似乎恨不得陈青云继续下去，多按一会儿。很快，她站起身走了两步，随后惊喜万分，露出一个足以令百花失色的笑容。“真的不疼了！陈秘书，谢谢你！”因为太过激动，江颜一个没站稳，跌进了陈青云的怀中。她穿的是紧身瑜伽服，前凸后翘，娇躯紧紧贴着陈青云的的胸膛。陈青云感受着怀中的软玉温香，咽了口唾沫，忍不住亢奋起来。“哎呀！”江颜只觉得他顶在自己腰间，她毕竟是过来人，哪能不清楚这是什么？但这惊人的规模，却远不是她丈夫杨天明能比的。一时间，她虽然害羞，心脏却怦怦直跳，两条美腿根本挪不动，只好依偎在陈青云的怀里，吐出温热的气息。这可难为了陈青云，被她吐出的气息弄得抓心挠肝，反应也越来越强烈，忍不住将手伸向她的翘臀。但就在这时，江颜清醒过来，立刻拉开了距离，低着头不敢与他对视。陈青云也一阵懊恼，暗道自己太急了，万一惹恼了她可怎么办？

岂料下一刻，江颜并没有生气，而是望着他说道：“陈秘书，看在你帮了我的份上，我要提醒你一句，千万要小心赵书记！”“赵书记？”陈青云一愣。江颜犹豫了片刻，最终像是下了什么决定，才继续道：“我接下来说的话，你可要保密！”“就在一周前，赵书记联系过我老公，让他准备接任县长的位子。”什么？！陈青云脸色狂变，瞬间惊出了一身冷汗。唐志华是三天前出的车祸，但赵天雄却提前一周“未卜先知”。这足以证明，唐志华的死并非意外，和赵天雄脱不了关系！莫非派那些混混来搜刮u盘的，也是赵天雄？“谢谢你！”陈青云感激地握住了江颜的手，若非她提醒，自己恐怕还蒙在鼓里。与空降的唐志华不同，赵天雄扎根在松山县几十年，从一个最基层的科员，爬到了县委书记的宝座，可谓大权在握，只手遮天！县里各个机关，都有他的心腹。陈青云只是个小秘书，根本惹不起赵书记，所以必须抱紧眼前江颜的大腿！“江小姐，你住哪儿，我送你回去！”陈青云又说道。“不用麻烦，我住在碧水山庄，就几百米远！”江颜婉拒道。“现在这么晚了，外面不安全！而且你的脚还需要休养，我来背你吧！”说着，陈青云在她面前弯下腰。“这……”江颜犹豫了一下，还是用双臂环绕住他的脖子，随后饱满的上半身也压了过去。陈青云察觉到背上传来柔软的弹性，说不出的舒服，生怕自己失态，立刻背着她朝着碧水山庄走去。与此同时，江颜悄悄偷瞄他的侧脸，只觉得英俊帅气，心中犹如小鹿乱撞，俏脸都有些发烫。“陈秘书，你今年几岁？”“二十五。”“那我比你大三岁，咱们有缘，不如认你当个干弟弟？”江颜在他耳边呵气如兰。“好啊！能有这么漂亮的姐姐，是我几辈子修来的福气呢！”陈青云笑着说道。哪怕知道他是在恭维，但江颜依旧心花怒放，俏丽的面容更加光彩动人。“青云弟弟，你不光高大帅气，而且这么说话，一定交过许多女朋友吧？”“颜姐，你太看得起我了！我大学的确谈了一个，但人家嫌弃我穷，就分手了……”陈青云无奈道。“那是她没眼光，迟早会后悔的！既然你现在是单身，不如我给你介绍个女朋友，你喜欢什么样的？”江颜追问道。“这个……”

"Miss Jiang, let me take a look for you!" Chen Qingyun said."You know me?" Jiang Yan was a little surprised."My name is Chen Qingyun, and I am the secretary of County Magistrate Tang. I have met you and Deputy County Magistrate Yang before!" Chen Qingyun explained while bending down and pinching her feet."Ah!" Jiang Yan exclaimed, tears welling up in her painful eyes, looking pitiful."Your ankle is injured. If the blood stasis is not removed in time, it will only become more serious. Let me massage it for you!" Chen Qingyun said."Do you know medical skills?" Jiang Yan looked suspicious."My grandfather is an old Chinese medicine doctor. I have learned some skills since I was a child!" Chen Qingyun stretched out his hand and kneaded her feet.Jiang Yan is a dancer, but her feet are flawless, as smooth as jade, and her ten toes are painted with red nail polish. They are particularly sexy and you can't help but play with them.Perhaps because of fear, Jiang Yan's whole body tensed up and trembled slightly."Don't be afraid! I'm very gentle and won't hurt you!" Chen Qingyun said.Hearing this, Jiang Yan's pretty face turned even redder, as if she had been smeared with rouge, making her look so pretty.After all, it sounded like she was talking about that kind of thing... But soon, she felt that Chen Qingyun's big hands seemed to have magic power, which not only relieved the pain, but also brought indescribable comfort.If she hadn't bit her red lip, she might have lost her composure and screamed."Miss Jiang, the congestion has melted away. You can stand up and try!" Chen Qingyun withdrew his hand."So fast?" Jiang Yan felt a little disappointed, as if she wished Chen Qingyun could continue and press for a while longer.Soon, she stood up and took two steps, then she was so surprised that she showed a smile that could make a hundred flowers pale."It really doesn't hurt anymore! Secretary Chen, thank you!" Because she was so excited, Jiang Yan couldn't stand still and fell into Chen Qingyun's arms.She was wearing tight-fitting yoga clothes, with her front and back curved, and her delicate body pressed tightly against Chen Qingyun's chest.Chen Qingyun felt the warm fragrance of nephrite in his arms, swallowed, and couldn't help but become excited."Oops!" Jiang Yan only felt that he was pressing against her waist. After all, she was here, so how could she not know what this was?But the astonishing scale is far beyond what her husband Yang Tianming can compare with.For a moment, although she was shy, her heart was beating fast, and her beautiful legs could not move at all, so she had no choice but to nestle in Chen Qingyun's arms and exhale warm breath.This was difficult for Chen Qingyun. The breath she exhaled made him scratch his head, and his reaction became more and more intense. He couldn't help but reach out to her buttocks.But at this moment, Jiang Yan woke up and immediately distanced herself, lowering her head and not daring to look at him.Chen Qingyun was also annoyed for a while, secretly thinking that he was too impatient. What if he pissed her off?

Unexpectedly, the next moment, Jiang Yan was not angry, but looked at him and said, "Secretary Chen, for the sake of helping me, I want to remind you, be careful with Secretary Zhao!" "Secretary Zhao?" Chen Qingyun was stunned.Jiang Yan hesitated for a moment, and finally seemed to have made a decision before continuing: "What I say next, you must keep it secret!" "Just a week ago, Secretary Zhao contacted my husband and asked him to prepare to take over the position of county magistrate." What?!Chen Qingyun's face changed wildly, and he suddenly broke into a cold sweat.Tang Zhihua was in a car accident three days ago, but Zhao Tianxiong "predicted the unknown" a week in advance.This is enough to prove that Tang Zhihua's death was not an accident and had nothing to do with Zhao Tianxiong!Could it be that Zhao Tianxiong was the one who sent those gangsters to search for USB flash drives?"Thank you!" Chen Qingyun held Jiang Yan's hand gratefully. If she hadn't reminded him, he might still be in the dark.Unlike Tang Zhihua, who landed by air, Zhao Tianxiong has taken root in Songshan County for decades, climbing from the most basic clerk to the throne of county party committee secretary. It can be said that he holds great power, covering the sky with one hand!Every agency in the county has his confidants.Chen Qingyun is just a little secretary and can't afford to offend Secretary Zhao, so he must hug Jiang Yan's thigh tightly!"Miss Jiang, where do you live? I'll take you back!" Chen Qingyun said again."No need to bother, I live in Bishui Villa, just a few hundred meters away!" Jiang Yan declined politely."It's so late now, it's not safe outside! And your feet still need to rest, so I'll carry you!" As he said that, Chen Qingyun bent down in front of her."This..." Jiang Yan hesitated for a moment, then wrapped her arms around his neck, and then pressed her plump upper body against him.Chen Qingyun noticed the soft elasticity on his back, which was indescribably comfortable. For fear of losing his composure, Chen Qingyun immediately carried her towards Bishui Villa.At the same time, Jiang Yan secretly glanced at his side face and felt that he was handsome and handsome. Her heart was like a deer bumping around, and her pretty face was a little hot."Secretary Chen, how old are you this year?" "Twenty-five." "Then I'm three years older than you. We are destined, why don't we accept you as my godbrother?" Jiang Yan breathed in his ear."Okay! I am lucky to have such a beautiful sister in my lifetime!" Chen Qingyun said with a smile.Even though she knew he was complimenting her, Jiang Yan was still elated, and her pretty face was even more radiant."Brother Qingyun, you are not only tall and handsome, but you also talk like that. You must have had many girlfriends, right?" "Sister Yan, you think so highly of me! I did have a relationship with one in college, but they broke up because they thought I was poor..." Chen Qingyun said helplessly."That's because she has no vision. She will regret it sooner or later! Since you are single now, how about I introduce you to a girlfriend. What kind of girlfriend do you like?" Jiang Yan asked."this……"
